question: Please tell me the definition of magic, even if it’s just your own personal interpretation.
answer: You mean the definition of magic in Re: Zero, I guess? Magic is a paranormal power that alters mana passing through a gate into a form that has an effect on reality, I think. Also, power that exceeds your limits for the one you’ve fallen in love with is “The Magic of Love”, I think. Sorry for suddenly turning romantic.
